title: Label email mentions: saleor batch 3
description:
Label every email candidate line in these files of `saleor` (pinned commit `030c1676145d63154687fa394d1a4abb224b1ac2`). 18 candidate lines.

Files:
- `saleor/plugins/user_email/constants.py`
- `saleor/plugins/user_email/default_email_templates/request_email_change.html`

## Setup

```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b label/KDATAP-c71b7a origin/kdatap-46d893-labeling-base
pnpm install
pnpm run benchmark:materialize saleor
```

## Read first, in full

1. `.agents/skills/curate-scanner-evaluation-corpus/references/mention-attribute-labeling.md`
2. The worked example it points to: `tests/benchmark/repos/ghost/annotations/packets/example-ghost-batch-3.yaml`

## Do

- Input: the entries for the files above in `tests/benchmark/repos/saleor/annotations/packets/email-candidates.yaml`.
- Read each file from `tests/benchmark/.cache/repos/saleor@030c1676145d63154687fa394d1a4abb224b1ac2/`, with the surrounding code for every candidate line.
- Write exactly one record per candidate line to `tests/benchmark/repos/saleor/annotations/packets/KDATAP-c71b7a.yaml`, with `packet.kanbus_issue: KDATAP-c71b7a`, `packet.files` equal to the files above, and `review_state: proposed`.

## Rules

- Do not run the scanner or read scanner output, `annotations/mentions.yaml`, or other packets.
- Uncertain: `status: ambiguous` with a one-sentence rationale. Do not guess.
- Do not edit any file except your packet and `annotations/KDATAP-c71b7a/pass.md`.
- Do not assert `touches` or `group`.

## Finish

1. `pnpm run benchmark:validate-packet tests/benchmark/repos/saleor/annotations/packets/KDATAP-c71b7a.yaml` prints `OK`.
2. Record the pass in `annotations/KDATAP-c71b7a/pass.md`: files, record count, positive / negative / ambiguous counts, and anything you were unsure about.
3. Commit both files on `label/KDATAP-c71b7a`. The coordinator reviews, then moves this issue to awaiting-review.
